title: Shaam ke zindan may
body:
shaam ke zindan mein ye ghul hua
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
chin gaya jab zindigani ka maza
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
<<DIVIDER>>
maamta rakhe huwe thi dil pa haat
sochti thi chut gaya beti ka saath
qaid e gham mein aur sannata hua
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
shaam ke zindaan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh rahe thay zindagi ke teen saal
kar gayi sarwar ki dukhtar inteqal
kamsini mein zulm hai kitna bada
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
shaam ke zindaan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap hai masroof e girya is taraf
aur qayamat aa chuki hai us taraf
hazrate zainab se bano ne kaha
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
shaam ke zindaan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki baahon mein baahein daal kar
maut ka tay kar liya aakhir safar
dekhti baba ka kab tak raasta
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
shaam ke zindaan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
di kisi ne jaa ke zainab ko khabar
koi ye kehte huwe aaya nazar
is khadar shiddat se yaad aaye chacha
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
shaam ke zindaan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
deed ki khwahish thi poori hogayi
maa kalejaa thaam ke rone lagi
jab sar e sibte payambar aa gaya
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
shaam ke zindaan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e aakhir is liye tha intezar
dekh le soorat to aa jaye qaraar
karbala ke baad se dekha na tha
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
shaam ke zindaan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haddiya thi pyaas se sookhi hui
thi phupi ki godh mein baithi hui
dard ki shiddat ne jab hamla kiya
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
shaam ke zindaan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hi ishrat sada thi har taraf
ya ali e murtaza shaah e najaf
hasrata wa hasrata wa hasrata
mar gayi beemar ki choti behan
shaam ke zindaan mein...
author: Ishrat Lakhnavi
